subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI header logo/icon not displaying after 2026.3.24 update

question: Should OpenClaw support Control UI public assets from arbitrary or legacy no-base deep URLs such as `/connections/...` and `/webchat/favicon.svg`, or should support stay limited to documented root and configured `gateway.controlUi.basePath` routes?
rationale: Current source fixes the normal root logo path and configured-basePath public assets, while tests intentionally preserve 404 behavior for nested static-looking paths; choosing whether to broaden that contract is a maintainer product boundary decision.

options.title: Keep documented route contract
options.body: Treat root and configured-basePath routes as the supported behavior, close or reject the conflicting fork PR, and close this issue once that decision is recorded.

options.title: Support deep-route assets
options.body: Ask for a fresh same-repo PR that updates the Vite/index asset strategy and adds focused tests for hard-refreshing nested Control UI routes.

options.title: Split avatar follow-up
options.body: If maintainers believe the screenshot is primarily an avatar/auth fallback symptom, track that as a separate avatar issue instead of expanding this public-asset issue.

recommendation.title: Keep documented route contract
recommendation.body: Treat root and configured-basePath routes as the supported behavior, close or reject the conflicting fork PR, and close this issue once that decision is recorded.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent owner signal for the current Control UI public-asset and display architecture touched by any product-boundary change here.
